evidence.quote: This book is not the transcript of a consciousness.
The prompts were not neutral research questionnaires.
The first draft was rejected as emotionally thin.
No such validation has been completed for this volume.
The relevant distinction is not ambitious versus unambitious.
while admitting that most lives contain both.
Generative ambition is drawn toward a problem, craft, possibility, or contribution.
Reparative ambition is drawn toward a verdict it hopes to defeat.
